title: Designer
description:
About Pinterest:
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 As a Designer within Pinterest’s Paid Performance Marketing team, you’ll play an integral role in shaping how Pinterest shows up across the social and digital advertising landscape. You’ll concept, collaborate, and execute on a broad range of creative briefs from our world class Marketing team. The role requires passion for developing exceptional creative solutions and scalable design thinking.
 What you’ll do:
 Evolve and elevate Pinterest’s performance creative across social and digital touchpoints
 Create high-impact, globally recognized creative solutions that drive the business forward. Deliver work that demonstrates excellence both for the Pinterest brand and the industry at large.
 Iterate quickly and communicate ideas across various levels of fidelity, with the ability to receive feedback constructively as well as provide feedback to oth…

title: Working Student — AI Engineering & Document Intelligence
description:
Location: Hamburg, Germany · Part-time alongside your studies
 About Tracium https://www.linkedin.com/company/tracium/
 Tracium builds AI-assisted software that helps technical teams turn complex manuals into structured, traceable information. We combine document intelligence with S1000D authoring, starting with maritime applications.
 Your role Work alongside experienced engineers on practical AI problems involving real technical documents. You will contribute to experiments, evaluation, and product improvements while developing your engineering skills with guidance from the team.
 What you’ll do Explore document parsing, OCR, and structured information extraction.
 Build Python scripts and small prototypes using AI models.
 Prepare and maintain datasets for testing extraction and retrieval quality.
 Compare model outputs with source documents and investigate errors.
 Help automate evaluation and regression checks.
 Contribute to document processing workflows and internal tools.
 Document your findings and share what works, what fails, and why.
 What you bring Current enrolment in computer science, data science, mathematics, engineering, or a related degree.
 Hands-on Python development skills.
 Hands-on with Git, APIs, and data handling.
 Good understanding about LLMs, machine learning, document intelligence.
 Attention to detail and a willingness to test assumptions.
 Clear communication in English.
 What you’ll gain Practical experience with AI beyond simple chatbot demos.
 Guidance, code reviews, and exposure to production engineering.
 Ownership of manageable tasks with visible product impact.
 Experience working directly with an early-stage founding team.

Follow Tracium on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/tracium/ for product updates, engineering insights, and future opportunities.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin
description:
Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React – Berlin Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.
 Auf einen Blick Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD
 Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit
 Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote
 Standort: Berlin-Zehlendorf, direkt am S-Bahnhof Zehlendorf (S1)
 Produkt: Konsentas, ein Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement für Behörden
 Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung
 Die Rolle Unser Kernprodukt Konsentas ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.
 Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.
 Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.
 Deine Aufgaben Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen
 Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen
 Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln
 Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen
 Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden
 Unsere zwei Auszubildenden im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)
 Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilne…

title: Senior BI/Data Engineer
description:
Your Role in Our Story: 

As a Senior BI/Data Engineer at ACT, you will play a key role in modernizing and scaling our enterprise Data Platform. Combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership, you will design reliable, scalable data solutions across data integration, modelling, analytics engineering and platform architecture.

Beyond delivery, you will help shape our platform roadmap and engineering standards, with a focus on architecture, automation, performance, security and cost efficiency. Microsoft Fabric is an important part of our modernization journey, alongside technologies such as Databricks where they add value. You will also have the opportunity to explore practical applications of Generative AI across development, documentation and platform operations.

We value ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. In essence, your role involves:

  • Own and continuously improve key components of ACT’s Data Platform architecture and engineering standards.
  • Design and implement integrations for new source systems and build reliable, maintainable data pipelines.
  • Design, implement and document enterprise data models, including relational and dimensional models.
  • Develop, optimize and operate data pipelines and orchestration using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Functions and Logic Apps.
  • Plan and execute data migrations with appropriate validation, reconciliation, data-quality controls and operational monitoring.
  • Contribute to the modernization of the Data Platform using Microsoft Fabric and, where appropriate, Databricks and other modern data technologies.
  • Develop and maintain trusted semantic models that enable scalable Power BI reporting, analytics and emerging AI use cases.
